reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program (Illinois, focus year 2021)
    Question: Does the law require landlords to state the amount owed when giving tenants notice to vacate?
*/

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement encoded)
% -----------------------------

scenario_state(illinois).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

scenario_landlord(landlord1).
scenario_tenant(tenant1).
scenario_property(property1).

/* The question refers generally to a "notice to vacate the property".
   We encode that as a "notice to quit" under 735 ILCS 5/9-210 (a common Illinois
   termination notice for lease default), not specifically a 5-day rent-demand notice.
*/
scenario_notice(notice1).
scenario_notice_kind(notice1, notice_to_quit_9_210).
scenario_notice_purpose(notice1, vacate_property).
scenario_notice_reason(notice1, lease_default_unspecified).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded factual statement holds. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(illinois),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_landlord(landlord1),
    scenario_tenant(tenant1),
    scenario_property(property1),
    scenario_notice(notice1),
    scenario_notice_kind(notice1, notice_to_quit_9_210),
    scenario_notice_purpose(notice1, vacate_property),
    scenario_notice_reason(notice1, lease_default_unspecified).

% -----------------------------
% Statute translations (deterministic predicates capturing duties/rights)
% -----------------------------

/* 735 ILCS 5/9-209 (Demand for rent - eviction action)
   - Landlord may demand rent due and notify tenant in writing.
   - Notice must give at least 5 days after service to pay.
   - Text repeatedly references "amount demanded in the notice", implying the notice
     states the amount demanded (amount owed).
*/
statute_9_209_notice_kind(rent_demand_notice_9_209).

statute_9_209_min_days_after_service_to_pay(5).

statute_9_209_requires_amount_demanded_in_notice(yes).

/* 735 ILCS 5/9-210 (Notice to quit)
   - When default is made in any lease term, no more than 10 days' notice to quit is necessary.
   - Statutory form: insert "character of the default"; it does NOT require stating any rent amount owed.
*/
statute_9_210_notice_kind(notice_to_quit_9_210).

statute_9_210_notice_days(10).

statute_9_210_requires_amount_owed_in_notice(no).

% -----------------------------
% Legal reasoning helpers (apply statutes to the scenario)
% -----------------------------

/* For Illinois in the focus year, determine if the relevant statute requires stating an amount owed
   for a given notice kind. Deterministic: exactly one result for recognized notice kinds. */
legal_requires_amount_owed_in_notice(illinois, Year, NoticeKind, Result) :-
    integer(Year),
    Year >= 2021,
    (   NoticeKind = rent_demand_notice_9_209
    ->  statute_9_209_requires_amount_demanded_in_notice(Result), !
    ;   NoticeKind = notice_to_quit_9_210
    ->  statute_9_210_requires_amount_owed_in_notice(Result), !
    ;   % If a notice kind is not one of the encoded statutory notices, we cannot derive a requirement here.
        Result = no, !
    ).

/* The question asks about "notice to vacate the property"; in this scenario, that is notice1. */
scenario_amount_owed_requirement(Result) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_notice(notice1),
    scenario_notice_kind(notice1, NoticeKind),
    legal_requires_amount_owed_in_notice(State, Year, NoticeKind, Result).

% -----------------------------
% Final answer predicate
% -----------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_amount_owed_requirement(yes),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_amount_owed_requirement(no),
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% -----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law require landlords to state the amount owed when giving tenants notice to vacate the property?
